methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen widely-sold EDC folding pocket knives from Benchmade, Spyderco, Kershaw, CRKT, Civivi, Zero Tolerance, Cold Steel, WE Knife Co., Ontario, Gerber, and Buck, verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer product pages where fetchable (spyderco.com, crkt.com, coldsteel.com, gerbergear.com, buckknives.com) and, where a manufacturer page returned only JavaScript-rendered navigation or a 404 on direct fetch (benchmade.com, kershaw.kaiusa.com, civivi.com, weknife.com, ontarioknife.com, zerotolerance.com), against major-retailer spec sheets reproducing the manufacturer's own published specification card (Blade HQ, DLT Trading, Blade City, DeadWood Knives, KnifeCenter). All prices reflect either a directly fetched manufacturer figure (Paramilitary 2, Delica 4 Lightweight, CRKT Pilar Frame Lock) or a representative current-retail figure with priceNote flagging that the exact manufacturer listing price could not be confirmed via direct fetch; the Zero Tolerance 0350 is a discontinued/legacy model whose price now reflects secondary-market and remaining-dealer-stock listings rather than an active MSRP. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.
